raw_method_diff.name: Noise Ceiling Method Difference (Raw)
raw_method_diff.interpretation: Temporal drift indicator. Low = consistent structure across splits.

raw_random.name: Random Split-Half RDM Reliability (Raw)
raw_random.formula: Spearman correlation between RDMs from random run splits
raw_random.interpretation: Consistency of representational structure. Higher = more reliable.

raw_oddeven.name: Odd/Even Split-Half RDM Reliability (Raw)
raw_oddeven.formula: Spearman correlation between RDMs from odd vs even runs
raw_oddeven.interpretation: Temporally balanced reliability. Should match random if no drift.

proc_method_diff.name: Noise Ceiling Method Difference (Procrustes)
proc_method_diff.interpretation: Drift after removing geometric differences. Lower = better alignment.

raw_rdm_reliability.name: RDM Reliability (Raw)
raw_rdm_reliability.formula: Mean of random and oddeven split-half reliabilities
raw_rdm_reliability.interpretation: Overall RDM consistency. Negative = no consistent structure (noise).

temporal_autocorr.name: Temporal Autocorrelation (lag-1)
temporal_autocorr.interpretation: Temporal drift indicator. More negative = more drift.

drift_magnitude.name: Linear Drift Magnitude
drift_magnitude.formula: Mean absolute slope of linear fit across runs
drift_magnitude.interpretation: Average drift strength per voxel. Lower = more stable.

procrustes_disparity.name: Procrustes Disparity
procrustes_disparity.formula: Sum of squared residuals after optimal alignment
procrustes_disparity.interpretation: Geometric variability between runs. Lower = more similar geometry.
